name: Kankakee County, IL
findings: Kankakee County has 322 nonprofit organizations. 132 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 115 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Kankakee County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list membership
observations.text: 13 social and fraternal organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 26 would.

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 55% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through social and fraternal groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 26 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 55% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Union organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 9 union organizations here list membership, compared with about 4 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 55% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do union organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?
